{"program":"domain(person,[esteban,leah,oaklee,misael]).

% Anyone who loves designer brands and enjoys fine dining has luxurious tastes.
axiom(s1, rule([loves_designer_brands(X), enjoys_fine_dining(X)], luxurious_tastes(X))).

% Esteban loves designer brands.
axiom(s2, loves_designer_brands(esteban)).

% Leah thinks ahead or makes informed decisions.
axiom(s3, or(thinks_ahead(leah), makes_informed_decisions(leah))).

% Esteban values quality or has luxurious tastes.
axiom(s4, or(values_quality(esteban), luxurious_tastes(esteban))).

% If Oaklee craves attention, then he either listens to others or ignores advice, but not both.
axiom(s5, rule([craves_attention(oaklee)], xor(listens_to_others(oaklee), ignores_advice(oaklee)))).

% Esteban enjoys fine dining.
axiom(s6, enjoys_fine_dining(esteban)).

% Esteban craves attention.
axiom(s7, craves_attention(esteban)).

% Esteban has common sense.
axiom(s8, has_common_sense(esteban)).

% Misael loves designer brands.
axiom(s9, loves_designer_brands(misael)).

% If Esteban has luxurious tastes and ignores advice, then he invests recklessly.
axiom(s10, rule([luxurious_tastes(esteban), ignores_advice(esteban)], invests_recklessly(esteban))).

% Esteban does not listen to others.
axiom(s11, not(listens_to_others(esteban))).

% Oaklee does not listen to others.
axiom(s12, not(listens_to_others(oaklee))).

% Leah craves attention.
axiom(s13, craves_attention(leah)).

% If Esteban has common sense, then he lives frugally and makes informed decisions.
axiom(s14, rule([has_common_sense(esteban)], and(lives_frugally(esteban), makes_informed_decisions(esteban)))).

% If Misael has common sense, then he lives frugally and makes informed decisions.
axiom(s15, rule([has_common_sense(misael)], and(lives_frugally(misael), makes_informed_decisions(misael)))).

% For Esteban, either he lives frugally or spends excessively, but not both.
axiom(s16, xor(lives_frugally(esteban), spends_excessively(esteban))).

% Esteban either manages his finances or lives frugally.
axiom(s17, or(manages_finances(esteban), lives_frugally(esteban))).

% If Misael has luxurious tastes and ignores advice, then he invests recklessly.
axiom(s18, rule([luxurious_tastes(misael), ignores_advice(misael)], invests_recklessly(misael))).

% If Esteban craves attention, then he either listens to others or ignores advice, but not both.
axiom(s19, rule([craves_attention(esteban)], xor(listens_to_others(esteban), ignores_advice(esteban)))).

% Anyone who values responsibility makes informed decisions.
axiom(s20, rule([values_responsibility(X)], makes_informed_decisions(X))).

% Everyone who lacks self-control either accumulates debt or spends excessively (or both).
axiom(s21, rule([lacks_self_control(X)], or(accumulates_debt(X), spends_excessively(X)))).

% Leah enjoys fine dining.
axiom(s22, enjoys_fine_dining(leah)).

% Misael thinks ahead.
axiom(s23, thinks_ahead(misael)).","query":"labelled_explanation(face_financial_difficulties(esteban), Status, Package)"}
